description: Defines the OpenClawChatViewModel class managing chat session state, message handling, and interactions with a transport layer in a chat UI context.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: Manages chat session state, message flow, and interactions with transport layer for a chat UI.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view model with session key, transport, optional initial thinking level, and callback for thinking level changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads initial chat data by calling bootstrap.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes chat data by calling bootstrap.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches session list with optional limit.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session.

methods.name: selectThinkingLevel
methods.description: Selects a thinking level for the session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Selects a model for the session.

methods.name: addAttachments
methods.description: Loads and adds attachments from URLs.
